title: CrispPro 6-quart air fryer
summary: CrispPro is a 6-quart, 1700-watt air fryer for about four people at $89.99. It has six programs, a 170-400 F range, a dishwasher-safe basket and tray, a two-year warranty, and 14 units at Austin Central. Its dimensions are 12.1 x 10.8 x 12.4 inches.

topic: air fryer easy cleaning four people
title: KitchenEase 6.5-quart air fryer
summary: KitchenEase is a 6.5-quart, 1750-watt air fryer at $94.99 with eight programs, dishwasher-safe basket and tray, and a two-year warranty. It offers more capacity but occupies 13.6 x 12.4 x 13.1 inches of counter space. Nine units are at Austin South.

title: CleanCook 5.5-quart air fryer
summary: CleanCook is a compact 5.5-quart, 1600-watt model at $99 with a ceramic-coated dishwasher-safe basket, seven programs, and a three-year warranty. It measures 11.4 x 10.2 x 11.8 inches but offers slightly less capacity for four people. Six units are at Austin North.

title: AirLite 6-quart air fryer
summary: AirLite is a budget 6-quart, 1500-watt model at $69.99 with four programs and an 180-400 F range. Its basket requires hand washing and its warranty is one year. Eighteen units are at Austin South.

title: TwinCrisp 8-quart dual-basket air fryer
summary: TwinCrisp has two independent baskets totaling 8 quarts, 1800 watts, ten programs, and dishwasher-safe parts for $139.99. It cooks two foods at once but is large at 15.2 x 13.7 x 12.9 inches. Five units are at Austin Central.

title: TinyCrisp 3-quart air fryer
summary: TinyCrisp is a compact 3-quart model for one or two people at $49.99. It has a dishwasher-safe basket, four programs, and a one-year warranty, but is too small for typical four-person meals. Twenty-one units are at Austin South.

topic: air fryer glass basket easy cleaning
title: GlassView 5-quart air fryer
summary: GlassView uses a dishwasher-safe glass basket that lets the cook see food without opening it. The 5-quart, 1500-watt model costs $104.99 and weighs 14.3 pounds. Four units are at Austin Central.

title: QuietFry 6-quart air fryer
summary: QuietFry is a 6-quart ceramic-coated model designed for lower fan noise. It costs $119.99, includes seven programs, dishwasher-safe parts, and a three-year warranty. Seven units are at Austin North.

topic: air fryer smart wifi four people
title: SmartCrisp 6-quart air fryer
summary: SmartCrisp is a 6-quart Wi-Fi model with twelve programs, a 150-450 F range, and dishwasher-safe parts for $129.99. It adds remote monitoring but exceeds a $100 budget. Eight units are at Austin Central.

title: OvenFry 12-quart air fryer oven
summary: OvenFry is a 12-quart air fryer oven with racks and rotisserie accessories for $149.99. It handles large batches but weighs 21.4 pounds and needs 16.5 x 15.1 inches of counter area. Three units are at Austin South.

topic: air fryer stainless interior easy cleaning
title: SteelCrisp 6-quart air fryer
summary: SteelCrisp is a 6-quart model with a stainless-steel basket, eight programs, dishwasher-safe parts, and a three-year warranty for $109.99. Eleven units are at Austin North.

title: SlimFry 5-quart air fryer
summary: SlimFry is a narrow 5-quart model at $84.99 with dishwasher-safe parts and five programs. Its 9.8-inch width saves counter space, but capacity is tighter for four people. Twelve units are at Austin Central.

topic: air fryer premium easy cleaning four people
title: PureCrisp 6-quart air fryer
summary: PureCrisp is a 6-quart model with a PFAS-free ceramic coating, dishwasher-safe parts, nine programs, and a three-year warranty. It costs $124.99, with ten units at Austin South.
